name: McDonald's Fruit & Maple Oatmeal (Plain, No Cranberries)
whyItWorks: Whole grain rolled oats cooked with hot water and light cream (or water upon request). Rich in soothing soluble beta-glucan fiber that forms a gentle mucosal gel, bulking watery stools without abrasive roughness.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Fruit & Maple Oatmeal, asking to HOLD the dried cranberries and raisins (which present stricture risks). Stir in diced apples if tolerated.
